008package release;
009
010import release.support.*;
011
012import java.nio.file.Files;
013import java.nio.file.Path;
014import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
015import java.util.Arrays;
016import java.util.List;

018/**
019 * Orchestrates the full multi-module build and release process for the
020 * Glyco-PAINT software suite. This includes version bumping, compilation,
021 * packaging for macOS and Windows, and optionally tagging and pushing
022 * to GitHub.
023 * <p>
024 * The installers are the macOS .pkg and the Windows setup.exe (module packaging). The old
025 * installers (executable JARs, module paint-installer) are kept as a backup and only built with
026 * the option {@code --old-installers}.
027 */
028public class ReleaseNewVersion {
029
030    /**
031     * Entry point for the release tool. Provides an interactive menu or
032     * accepts command-line arguments.
033     *
034     * @param args command-line options:
035     *             <ul>
036     *               <li>{@code --release}: full release (version, build, commit, tag, push the tag)</li>
037     *               <li>{@code --old-installers}: also builds the old installers (backup)</li>
038     *             </ul>
039     *             Without {@code --release} the menu asks what to do.
040     */
041    public static void main(String[] args) {
042        boolean doRelease     = false;  // full release: version + tag + push
043        boolean oldInstallers = false;  // also build the old installers (backup)
044
045        for (String arg : args) {
046            if ("--release".equalsIgnoreCase(arg)) {
047                doRelease = true;
048
049            } else if ("--old-installers".equalsIgnoreCase(arg)) {
050                oldInstallers = true;
051
052            } else {
053                System.err.println("❌ Unknown option: " + arg);
054                System.err.println();
055                System.err.println("Usage:");
056                System.err.println("  java -jar release-tool.jar [--release] [--old-installers]");
057                System.err.println();
058                System.err.println("Options:");
059                System.err.println("  --release        Full release: drop -SNAPSHOT, build, tag & push, then bump to the next SNAPSHOT.");
060                System.err.println("  --old-installers Also build the old installers (executable JARs), kept as a backup.");
061                System.err.println();
062                System.err.println("Without --release the menu asks: rebuild only or full release.");
063                System.exit(1);
064            }
065        }
066
067        if (!doRelease) {
068            doRelease = askForRelease();
069        }
070
071        System.out.println("✅ Effective configuration:");
072        System.out.println("   release       : " + (doRelease ? "yes" : "no (rebuild only)"));
073        System.out.println("   old installers: " + (oldInstallers ? "yes" : "no"));
074        System.out.println();
075
076        try {
077            new ReleaseNewVersion().run(doRelease, oldInstallers);
078        } catch (Exception e) {
079            System.err.println("❌ Build process failed: " + e.getMessage());
080            e.printStackTrace();
081            System.exit(1);
082        }
083    }
084
085    /** The menu: 1 rebuild only (the default), 2 full release. */
086    private static boolean askForRelease() {
087        final Path parentPom = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("pom.xml");
088        String currentVersion = PomUtils.getVersionFromPom(parentPom);
089        if (currentVersion == null) {
090            System.err.println("❌ Cannot determine current version from parent POM.");
091            System.exit(1);
092        }
093        VersionInfo info = PomUtils.computeVersions(currentVersion);
094
095        System.out.println();
096        System.out.println("Current version: " + currentVersion);
097        System.out.println();
098        System.out.println("Choose an action:");
099        System.out.println("  1) Rebuild only");
100        System.out.println("     • Version stays         : " + currentVersion);
101        System.out.println("     • No release/tag created");
102        System.out.println();
103        System.out.println("  2) Full release (version + tag + push)");
104        System.out.println("     • Release version       : " + info.releaseVersion);
105        System.out.println("     • Next dev version      : " + info.nextDevVersion);
106        System.out.println();
107        System.out.print("Enter 1 or 2: ");
108
109        boolean release = false;
110        try {
111            byte[] buf = new byte[32];
112            int read = System.in.read(buf);
113            String choice = read > 0 ? new String(buf, 0, read).trim() : "";
114            switch (choice) {
115                case "1" -> release = false;
116                case "2" -> release = true;
117                default -> System.out.println("Invalid option. Defaulting to: rebuild only.");
118            }
119        } catch (Exception e) {
120            System.out.println("Input error. Defaulting to: rebuild only.");
121        }
122        System.out.println();
123        return release;
124    }
125
126    private void run(boolean doRelease, boolean oldInstallers) throws Exception {
127        System.out.println("=== Building Glyco-PAINT apps for macOS and Windows ===");
128
129        // The Windows installer needs makensis: check before anything is changed
130        MavenSupport.requireMakensis();
131
132        final Path parentPom = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("pom.xml");
133        String currentVersion = PomUtils.getVersionFromPom(parentPom);
134        if (currentVersion == null) {
135            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not determine version from parent pom.xml");
136        }
137        if (!currentVersion.endsWith("-SNAPSHOT")) {
138            System.out.println("⚠️  Parent POM is not a SNAPSHOT (" + currentVersion + ") — converting to snapshot for continued development.");
139            currentVersion = currentVersion + "-SNAPSHOT";
140        }
141
142        if (doRelease) {
143            checkReadyForRelease(PomUtils.computeVersions(currentVersion).releaseVersion);
144        }
145
146        VersionInfo versionInfo;
147
148        // -------------------------------------------------------------
149        // MODE 1 : Rebuild only
150        // -------------------------------------------------------------
151        if (!doRelease) {
152
153            System.out.println("ℹ️  Rebuild-only mode. No version changes.");
154            System.out.println("ℹ️  Using version: " + currentVersion);
155
156            MavenSupport.installModulesAndDependencies(PathsConfig.MODULES);
157
158            // continue into build-artifacts block using currentVersion
159            versionInfo = new VersionInfo(currentVersion, currentVersion + "-IGNORED");
160
161        }
162        // -------------------------------------------------------------
163        // MODE 2 : Full release
164        // -------------------------------------------------------------
165        else {
166
167            versionInfo = PomUtils.computeVersions(currentVersion);
168
169            System.out.println("🚀 Full release mode.");
170            System.out.println("🔢  Current : " + currentVersion);
171            System.out.println("🏷️  Release : " + versionInfo.releaseVersion);
172            System.out.println("🚀 Next dev : " + versionInfo.nextDevVersion);
173
174            MavenSupport.installParentPomAsRelease(versionInfo.releaseVersion);
175            MavenSupport.alignAllPomVersions(versionInfo.releaseVersion);
176            PomUtils.removeSnapshotFromAllPoms(PathsConfig.BASE_PATH);
177
178            MavenSupport.installModulesAndDependencies(PathsConfig.MODULES);
179        }
180
181        // -------------------------------------------------------------
182        // Build artifacts (shared across all modes)
183        // -------------------------------------------------------------
184        Path buildRoot     = PathsConfig.BUILDS_PATH.resolve("Glyco-PAINT-" + versionInfo.releaseVersion);
185        Path windowsPath   = buildRoot.resolve("Windows");
186        Path macOSPath     = buildRoot.resolve("macOS");
187        Path pluginPath    = buildRoot.resolve("Plugins");
188        Path installerPath = buildRoot.resolve("Installers");
189
190        Files.createDirectories(buildRoot);
191        Files.createDirectories(windowsPath);
192        Files.createDirectories(macOSPath);
193        Files.createDirectories(pluginPath);
194        Files.createDirectories(installerPath);
195
196        for (String module : PathsConfig.MODULES) {
197            Path moduleDir = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve(module);
198            System.out.println("\n---------------------------------------------");
199            System.out.println("🏗️  Module: " + module);
200            System.out.println("---------------------------------------------");
201
202            MavenSupport.buildAndCollect(moduleDir, "-Pwindows-exe", "*.exe", windowsPath);
203            MavenSupport.buildAndCollectMacApp(moduleDir, "-Pmacos-appbundle", macOSPath);
204
205            List<String> installCmd = Arrays.asList(
206                    "mvn",
207                    "-q",
208                    "install",
209                    "-DskipTests",
210                    "-Dmaven.repo.local=" + System.getProperty("user.home") + "/.m2/repository",
211                    "-DargLine=--add-opens=java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED "
212                            + "--add-opens=java.base/sun.misc=ALL-UNNAMED "
213                            + "--add-opens=java.base/sun.nio.ch=ALL-UNNAMED "
214                            + "-XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions"
215            );
216
217            ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(installCmd);
218            pb.directory(moduleDir.toFile());
219            Process p = ProcessRunner.startAndFilterOutput(pb, module);
220            if (p.waitFor() != 0) {
221                throw new RuntimeException("❌ Failed to install " + module);
222            }
223        }
224
225        // Fiji plugin
226        Path pluginDir = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("paint-fiji-plugin");
227        if (Files.exists(pluginDir.resolve("pom.xml"))) {
228            MavenSupport.buildAndCollect(pluginDir, "", "*-jar-with-dependencies.jar", pluginPath);
229        }
230
231        // Glyco-PAINT.app (paint-app): the Launcher and the four apps with a built-in Java
232        // runtime, next to the separate apps in the macOS payload. Built from the project root
233        // with -am, so Maven also builds the Launcher and the apps it bundles. macOS only:
234        // jpackage builds for the system it runs on.
235        MavenSupport.runMaven(Arrays.asList(
236                "mvn", "-q", "-B", "package", "-DskipTests",
237                "-pl", "paint-app", "-am"
238        ), PathsConfig.BASE_PATH, "paint-app");
239        Path glycoPaintApp = FileOps.requireArtifact(
240                PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("paint-app/target/bundle"), "Glyco-PAINT.app");
241        FileOps.copyDirectory(glycoPaintApp, macOSPath.resolve("Glyco-PAINT.app"));
242
243        // -------------------------------------------------------------
244        // Installers: the macOS .pkg and the Windows setup.exe; the old ones only on request
245        // -------------------------------------------------------------
246        if (oldInstallers) {
247            buildOldInstallers(versionInfo.releaseVersion, macOSPath, windowsPath, pluginPath, installerPath);
248        }
249        MavenSupport.buildInstallers(versionInfo.releaseVersion, installerPath);
250
251        // A released version supersedes its test build (Glyco-PAINT-<version>-SNAPSHOT).
252        FileOps.removeSupersededSnapshotBuild(buildRoot);
253
254        // -------------------------------------------------------------
255        // Post-release: commit + tag the release, bump to next SNAPSHOT, push the tag
256        // -------------------------------------------------------------
257        if (doRelease) {
258            String tagName = "v" + versionInfo.releaseVersion;
259
260            // The tag goes on the commit with the release version, so checking it out gives
261            // exactly what was released.
262            GitUtils.commitReleaseAndTag(versionInfo.releaseVersion, PathsConfig.BASE_PATH);
263
264            System.out.println("\n🚀 Preparing next development iteration...");
265
266            String nextSnapshot = versionInfo.nextDevVersion;
267
268            MavenSupport.runMaven(MavenSupport.versionsSetCommand(nextSnapshot, false),
269                                  PathsConfig.BASE_PATH, "versions:set (parent only)");
270
271            GitUtils.commitTrackedPoms("Bump project to " + nextSnapshot + " for next development cycle",
272                                       PathsConfig.BASE_PATH);
273
274            GitUtils.pushTag(tagName, PathsConfig.BASE_PATH);
275
276            System.out.println("✅ Release complete. Tag pushed: " + tagName);
277        }
278
279        System.out.println("\n🎉 All builds complete for " + versionInfo.releaseVersion);
280    }
281
282    /**
283     * The old installers: executable JARs that need Java 21 on the user's machine, each with a
284     * payload.zip of the separate apps and the plugin. Kept as a backup; only built with
285     * {@code --old-installers}.
286     */
287    private static void buildOldInstallers(String version, Path macOSPath, Path windowsPath,
288                                           Path pluginPath, Path installerPath) throws Exception {
289        Path macInstallerRes = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("paint-installer/paint-installer-macos/src/main/resources");
290        Path winInstallerRes = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("paint-installer/paint-installer-windows/src/main/resources");
291        Files.createDirectories(macInstallerRes);
292        Files.createDirectories(winInstallerRes);
293
294        Path macPayload = macInstallerRes.resolve("payload.zip");
295        Path winPayload = winInstallerRes.resolve("payload.zip");
296
297        Files.deleteIfExists(macPayload);
298        Files.deleteIfExists(winPayload);
299
300        FileOps.zipPayload(macOSPath, pluginPath, macPayload);
301        FileOps.zipPayload(windowsPath, pluginPath, winPayload);
302
303        MavenSupport.runMavenModule("paint-installer/paint-installer-macos", version);
304        MavenSupport.runMavenModule("paint-installer/paint-installer-windows", version);
305
306        Path macTarget = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("paint-installer/paint-installer-macos/target");
307        Path winTarget = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("paint-installer/paint-installer-windows/target");
308
309        // Ask for the exact artifact. Do NOT pattern-match here: maven-shade leaves the
310        // pre-shade jar behind as original-<name>.jar next to the real one, and picking the
311        // newest match would be a race that can ship a non-runnable installer.
312        Path macBuilt = FileOps.requireArtifact(
313                macTarget, "paint-installer-macos-" + version + ".jar");
314        Path winBuilt = FileOps.requireArtifact(
315                winTarget, "paint-installer-windows-" + version + ".jar");
316
317        Path macFinal = installerPath.resolve("Glyco-PAINT-Installer-macOS-" + version + ".jar");
318        Path winFinal = installerPath.resolve("Glyco-PAINT-Installer-Windows-" + version + ".jar");
319
320        Files.copy(macBuilt, macFinal, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
321        Files.copy(winBuilt, winFinal, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
322    }
323
324    /**
325     * Stops a full release before it changes anything if the working tree has uncommitted
326     * changes (they would end up mixed with, or left out of, the release commit) or if the
327     * release tag already exists.
328     */
329    private static void checkReadyForRelease(String releaseVersion) throws Exception {
330        List<String> changes = GitUtils.uncommittedChanges(PathsConfig.BASE_PATH);
331        if (!changes.isEmpty()) {
332            throw new IllegalStateException("The working tree has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them before a release:\n   "
333                                                    + String.join("\n   ", changes));
334        }
335        String tagName = "v" + releaseVersion;
336        if (GitUtils.tagExists(tagName, PathsConfig.BASE_PATH)) {
337            throw new IllegalStateException("Tag " + tagName + " already exists.");
338        }
339    }
340}
